params.body:
A test from #300 read the model this machine's saved Settings pick for `content-chat`, not the default the code ships. On the pipeline box, a phase saved in Settings (`store/model-config.json`) outranks the default, so with the chat saved on Haiku there the test fails, and `bin/auto-deploy` keeps the previous commit and holds the round back. That would leave the box on the pipeline from before #300: the Studio then sends `format: deck` and nothing changes, which is what was seen live.

The test now checks `PHASE_DEFAULTS['content-chat']` (exported already), which is what #300 meant to pin. Checked both ways with a saved Haiku setting in `store/model-config.json`: the test on main fails, this one passes.

After this lands and deploys: if Settings still saves Haiku for the Studio chat, the live chat keeps running on Haiku. Setting it to Sonnet 5.5 in the Observatory's Settings is what moves it.
params.title: Fix: the chat-model test read the box's saved Settings and held every deploy back
